## VariationMaps Step 8 newly needs

`stable_envs.compat.worldmodel.VARIATION_MAPS` is what makes a cell's appearance reachable from a `stable_worldmodel` variation name. A cell with swm leaves and no map is a **Gate-F gap**: the renderer is right and the caller cannot ask it for the appearance the wrapper offers. Step 7 added seven cells; the ones with leaves and no map are listed first because they are new debt, then the pre-existing ones, which are not.
